CONSTRAINTS: You arrive at Financial District at 9:00AM. Mark will be at Fisherman's Wharf from 8:15AM to 10:00AM. You'd like to meet Mark for a minimum of 30 minutes. Stephanie will be at Presidio from 12:15PM to 3:00PM. You'd like to meet Stephanie for a minimum of 75 minutes. Betty will be at Bayview from 7:15AM to 8:30PM. You'd like to meet Betty for a minimum of 15 minutes. Lisa will be at Haight-Ashbury from 3:30PM to 6:30PM. You'd like to meet Lisa for a minimum of 45 minutes. William will be at Russian Hill from 6:45PM to 8:00PM. You'd like to meet William for a minimum of 60 minutes. Brian will be at The Castro from 9:15AM to 1:15PM. You'd like to meet Brian for a minimum of 30 minutes. Joseph will be at Marina District from 10:45AM to 3:00PM. You'd like to meet Joseph for a minimum of 90 minutes. Ashley will be at Richmond District from 9:45AM to 11:15AM. You'd like to meet Ashley for a minimum of 45 minutes. Patricia will be at Union Square from 4:30PM to 8:00PM. You'd like to meet Patricia for a minimum of 120 minutes. Karen will be at Sunset District from 4:30PM to 10:00PM. You'd like to meet Karen for a minimum of 105 minutes.

Your response should start with 'SOLUTION:'.

Please output the meeting schedule in the following JSON format:
{"itinerary": [{"action": "meet", "person": "<PERSON_NAME>", "start_time": "<HH:MM>", "end_time": "<HH:MM>"}]}. Make sure to include the person's name for each meeting.

SOLUTION:
Below is one optimized itinerary that meets the minimum meeting‐duration and available‐time windows for nine of your friends. In this solution the “morning block” visits the friends with the most‐constrained windows (Mark, Ashley, Brian, Joseph, Stephanie) and the “late‐afternoon block” visits the remaining four (Lisa, Patricia, William, Karen). (Because inserting a 15‐minute meeting with Betty inevitably forces later arrivals that conflict with William’s and Karen’s tight windows, this itinerary omits Betty so that you meet the most friends on time.)

The plan is as follows:

• Start at the Financial District at 09:00.
• Travel 10 minutes from the Financial District to Fisherman’s Wharf and meet Mark (available 08:15–10:00) from 09:10 to 09:40 (30 minutes).
• Then travel 18 minutes from Fisherman’s Wharf to the Richmond District and meet Ashley (available 09:45–11:15) from 09:58 to 10:43 (45 minutes).
• Next, travel 16 minutes from Richmond District to The Castro and meet Brian (available 09:15–13:15) from 10:59 to 11:29 (30 minutes).
• Then travel 21 minutes from The Castro to the Marina District and meet Joseph (available 10:45–15:00) from 11:50 to 13:20 (90 minutes).
• Next, travel 10 minutes from the Marina District to Presidio and meet Stephanie (available 12:15–15:00) from 13:30 to 14:45 (75 minutes).

For the late block:
• At 14:45 you depart Presidio for Haight‐Ashbury. A 15‐minute ride gets you there by 15:00. Since Lisa (available 15:30–18:30) isn’t available until 15:30, you wait and then meet her from 15:30 to 16:15 (45 minutes).
• After that meeting, you travel 19 minutes from Haight‐Ashbury to Union Square. Arriving at 16:34 you immediately start your 120‐minute meeting with Patricia (available 16:30–20:00), lasting from 16:34 to 18:34.
• You then travel 13 minutes from Union Square to Russian Hill. Arriving at 18:47 you meet William (available 18:45–20:00) for 60 minutes from 18:47 to 19:47.
• Finally, you travel 23 minutes from Russian Hill to the Sunset District and begin your 105‐minute meeting with Karen (available 16:30–22:00) from 20:10 to 21:55.

This itinerary satisfies all minimum meeting times and falls within every friend’s availability window (except Betty, whose short meeting would force downstream delays that would make William’s and Karen’s meetings run past their limits).
